title: Blood Pressure and Neural Regulation
word_count_method: Whitespace-separated p.teaching-prose tokens containing a Unicode letter or digit; HTML tags and common entities removed; excludes figures, UI, questions, answers, revision, references and headings.
comparison: Adjacent 7.B.01 has approximately 14,231 whitespace-delimited teaching words; 7.B.07 has 13,786 genuine teaching words within required range.

syllabus.csir: January 2026 merged and separate Life Sciences Unit 7.B syllabus
syllabus.mp_set: 2024 mirrored syllabus scan, official-host copy not independently authenticated

coverage_matrix.scope: Arterial pressure determinants; systolic, diastolic, pulse and MAP
coverage_matrix.reasoning: waveforms, time average, CO/SVR, compliance and RC model
cuff and Korotkoff, oscillometry, hydrostatic error, direct calibration
isolated perfusion, Piezo channels, IX and X, pressure encoding
NTS, CVLM, RVLM, vagal nuclei, beta1, alpha1, M2 and feedback gain
central filling, low-pressure sensory pathways, orthostatic dataset
peripheral chemical stimuli, ventilatory conditions, autonomic outcomes
response curves, exercise studies, variability and renal boundaries

review.scientific: Internal scientific pass: pressure vs flow, waveform averaging, ideal RC derivation, hydrostatic pressure, mechanotransduction, afferents IX/X, inhibitory CVLM relay, receptor-specific autonomic effects, ventilation-dependent chemoreflex and reset-versus-gain checked; numerical examples recalculated and illustrative data labelled. Revised cuff sound mechanism and closure geometry.
review.editorial: Separate internal editorial pass: reviewed progressive structure, expanded all 15 misconception checks, diversified 54 questions, added diagrams for mechanotransduction, hydrostatic gradient and chemoreflex, responsive tables, diagram zoom, inline evidence links and reader controls.

score_basis: Internal rubric: full mapped scope and depth, coherent foundation-to-application progression, worked equations and experiments; deductions for limited full-text reference checking, no rendered SVG inspection, assessment balance toward short responses, and untested live browser interactions and accessibility.
limitations: Internal reviews only; no independent external peer review.
Official CSIR syllabus inspected; MP SET alignment checked against a mirrored 2024 syllabus, not an authenticated current official-host copy.
Several references checked via indexed excerpts/abstracts, not every full text.
SVG geometry and accessibility inspected statically; no browser-rendered desktop/mobile or keyboard interaction test.
Live HTTP and deployment verification pending after production publication.
